autoSave.description: General--Save changes automatically shortly after you stop typing.

autoSaveDelay.description: General--How long to wait after the last keystroke before saving (shown in seconds).

previewModeOnFinderOpen.description: General--Open documents from Finder in reading view.

language.description: General--The language Mark use. 'system' follows the OS preferred languages (C-45).

endOfLine.description: General--Line endings used for new files and when saving.

zoom.description: General--Retired percentage zoom (C-49). Kept only so a stored value can be migrated once into fontSize (clamp(round(16 × zoom))) and reset to 1; nothing reads it afterwards.--internal

titleBarStyle.description: Appearance--Window title bar: Mark's own (with tabs) or the system one. Requires a restart. Windows and Linux only.

wordWrapInToc.description: Appearance--Wrap long headings in the outline.

baseFontSize.description: Appearance--The Settings font size that Zoom Actual Size (CmdOrCtrl+0) restores; zoom steps never overwrite it (C-49).--internal

editorLineWidth.description: Appearance--Writing area width. An empty string or suffixes of ch (characters), px (pixels) or % (percentage) are allowed; empty means unlimited.

theme.description: Appearance--The theme family applied in Mark.

followSystemTheme.description: Appearance--Auto mode: follow the system appearance (light or dark).

lightModeTheme.description: Appearance--Theme family member used when the appearance is light.

darkModeTheme.description: Appearance--Theme family member used when the appearance is dark.

autoCheck.description: Editor--Check off tasks with a click.

hideQuickInsertHint.description: Editor--Hide the insert hint shown on empty lines.

hideLinkPopup.description: Editor--Hide the link preview shown when the cursor is on a link.

spellcheckerNoUnderline.description: Editor--Underline misspelled words (inverted key: true disables the underline).

spellcheckerLanguage.description: Editor--Spelling language (non-macOS; macOS detects the document language).

codeFontFamily.description: Editor--Font family used in code blocks.

codeFontSize.description: Editor--Code text size in pixels, the range is 12 ~ 28.

codeBlockLineNumbers.description: Editor--Show line numbers in code blocks (opt-in since C-38 T-005; one number per logical line, aligned also with wrapped lines)

codeBlockLineNumbersMigrated.description: Editor--One-time marker that the C-38 T-005 codeBlockLineNumbers default migration ran (stored true -> false); once set the user's choice is kept--internal

wrapCodeBlocks.description: Editor--Wrap long lines in code blocks.

preferLooseListItem.description: Markdown--Spacing between list items (true = spaced, false = compact).

bulletListMarker.description: Markdown--The marker used in bullet list

mathEnabled.description: Markdown--Math formulas rendered with KaTeX ($…$ and $$…$$).

superSubScript.description: Markdown--Superscript and subscript (^text^ and ~text~, Pandoc extension).

frontmatterType.description: Markdown--Front matter format (the delimiter of the metadata block).

frontmatterProperties.description: Markdown--Show front matter as a properties table.

imageInsertAction.description: Advanced--When I add an image: copy it into a folder, keep its original location, or upload to the cloud.

imagePreferRelativeDirectory.description: Advanced--Save images next to the document (relative folder + relative links).

imageRelativeDirectoryName.description: Advanced--Image folder name (${filename} inserts the document's name).

customCss.description: Advanced--Custom CSS applied on top of the selected theme.

sideBarVisibility.description: View--Whether the side bar is visible.--internal

sourceCodeModeEnabled.description: View--Whether the source-code mode is enabled by default.--internal

searchExclusions.description: Searcher--List of glob patterns to exclude from search.--internal

searchMaxFileSize.description: Searcher--The maximal file size (<maxFileSize><suffix>). Suffixes of K, M or G are allowed if not suffix is given the number is treated as bytes.--internal

searchIncludeHidden.description: Searcher--Whether to search in hidden files and directories.--internal

searchNoIgnore.description: Searcher--Whether to ignore ignore files like .gitignore.--internal
